title: Log-Analyzer-Bot Output
description: Machine-readable CI/CD failure diagnosis. Always a flat JSON object — no markdown wrapper, no code fences.

status.description: "failed" when a failure is detected; "passed" when the log contains no errors.

error_summary.description: One sentence, maximum 20 words. Describes the root cause failure. No hedging language.

failing_step.description: The CI step name or tool that failed (e.g. "flake8", "CodeQL Analysis", "npm install", "pytest"). "N/A" when status is "passed".

affected_file.description: File path and line number in the format "path/to/file.ext:NN". Omit ":NN" if line number is unavailable. "N/A" if no specific file is implicated or status is "passed".

suggested_fix.description: A specific, executable CLI command or minimal code patch. Abstract recommendations are not permitted. "N/A" when status is "passed".
examples: Replace the literal credential with process.env.CREDENTIAL_NAME and add CREDENTIAL_NAME to your CI environment secrets.

constraints.output_format: Raw JSON only. No markdown code fences. No surrounding text.
constraints.fix_quality: suggested_fix must be a runnable command or patch derivable from the log alone.
constraints.file_format: affected_file must match pattern path:line or be N/A.
